label: Installs solar panels or solar shingles
description: true only if the contractor says it installs solar panels or solar roofing (e.g. GAF Timberline Solar); false only if it says it does not; otherwise null.

label: Number of installation crews
description: The number of roofing or installation crews the text states ("four crews" is 4). null when no crew count is written.

label: Main roofing material installed
description: The roofing material the contractor presents as its main line of work; mixed when several are presented equally.
